The green line, representing Consistency-Uni, begins at an AL value of approximately 2.6, not 2.
The data point on the green line (Consistency-Uni) with a BLEU score of approximately 28 has an AL value of about 3.6, not 4.
The data point on the green line (Consistency-Uni) with a BLEU score near 30 has an AL value of about 5.2, not 6. The BLEU value is also closer to 30.1 than 30.5.
The red line, representing Consistency-Bi, starts at an AL value of approximately 1.6, not 2.
The data point on the red line (Consistency-Bi) with a BLEU score of approximately 28.5 has an AL value of about 3.6, not 4.
The data point on the red line (Consistency-Bi) with a BLEU score of approximately 30.5 has an AL value of about 5.2, not 6.
The final BLEU score for the purple line (Consistency-CE) is approximately 31.3 or 31.4, not 31.5.
